key.flightsuit.suit_toggle: Suit (tap: call / board / step out, hold: all home)
tooltip.flightsuit.piece.chestplate: Arc reactor battery + palm repulsor (empty-hand right click).
tooltip.flightsuit.piece.leggings: Power assist: speed, step-up, softer landings.
tooltip.flightsuit.capsule.hint: Right click or G: suit up. Hold G: pack the worn suit away.
tooltip.flightsuit.energy_cell: Charges the worn suit by %s FE (or a capsule in the other hand).
message.flightsuit.no_suit: No stored suit found. Carry a filled suit capsule.
message.flightsuit.already_wearing: Take off the suit pieces you are wearing first (G packs them).
tooltip.flightsuit.edith: G: call the main suit · G while suited: step out (companion) · hold G: all suits home. Command HUD.
message.flightsuit.station_occupied: This station already holds a suit.
message.flightsuit.no_main_station: No main station. Right click a suit station to set one.
message.flightsuit.station_other_dimensi: Your main station is in another dimension.
message.flightsuit.station_empty: Your main station has no suit.
message.flightsuit.suit_stepped_out: Stepped out. The suit stays with you as a companion.
message.flightsuit.companion_no_power: Companion suit out of power. Board it or recover it.
message.flightsuit.companion_damaged: Companion suit damaged. Returning for repairs.
message.flightsuit.suit_needs_repair: Suit damaged - needs repair. Dock it at a station.
tooltip.flightsuit.cleaner_robot: Use on a cleaner dock to set it down. Right click robot: clean now · sneak: pick up. Sneak + empty-hand click the dock: draw an area · click with a stick: erase areas
tooltip.flightsuit.hover_car: Use on the ground to pop out the car. Ride: right click · Pack: sneak + empty hand · Charge: energy cell, or park near power blocks
message.flightsuit.cleaner_area_start: Drawing an area: right click the corner blocks, click the first corner again to close (sneak-click the dock to cancel)
message.flightsuit.cleaner_area_limit: A dock holds at most 8 areas.
message.flightsuit.cleaner_area_corner_c: Corner %s saved · click the first corner to close
message.flightsuit.cleaner_no_areas: No cleaning areas. Sneak + empty-hand click the dock to draw one.
message.flightsuit.cleaner_low_power: Dock power too low (2,000 FE per run).
message.flightsuit.cleaner_needs_dock: Use it on a cleaner robot dock.
message.flightsuit.cleaner_dock_taken: This dock already has a robot.
tooltip.flightsuit.class.stealth: Stealth: sneak in the full set to cloak · freeze beam instead of repulsor · 48-block helmet sensors
screen.flightsuit.wheel_hint: Click: deploy · Shift+click: swap in · Right click: set main · Center: all suits
message.flightsuit.wheel_needs_edith: The suit wheel needs EDITH glasses.
message.flightsuit.companion_already_out: That suit is already deployed. Shift+click to swap into it.
screen.flightsuit.wheel_hint_remote: Ctrl+click: remote pilot (your body stays behind, defenceless)
hud.flightsuit.remote.title: REMOTE · %s
message.flightsuit.remote_connected: Remote link: %s. Your body stays where you left it.
message.flightsuit.remote_disconnected: Link closed. The suit stays out as a companion.
message.flightsuit.remote_disconnected_h: Link closed. The suit was far off, so it flies back to its station.
message.flightsuit.remote_recalled: Link closed. The suit is heading home.
message.flightsuit.remote_broken: The suit gave out and the link dropped. It's going in for repairs.
message.flightsuit.remote_no_power: The suit ran out of power and the link dropped.
message.flightsuit.remote_body_hit: Your body is under attack! Link severed.
message.flightsuit.remote_recovered: Cleaned up an interrupted remote link. The suit went home.
message.flightsuit.remote_take_off_suit: Take your suit off before remote-piloting.
message.flightsuit.remote_dismount: Get off your ride before remote-piloting.
message.flightsuit.remote_full_set: Only a full suit can be remote-piloted.
message.flightsuit.remote_no_charge: That suit has no power. Charge it first.
message.flightsuit.remote_capsule: A suit in a capsule can't be piloted. Deploy it first.
message.flightsuit.station_no_room: Not enough room for the station (3x3, 4 high, pillars at the back).
tooltip.flightsuit.class.phantom: Phantom: card throws · Carte Noir · [X] Judgment Draw · [C] card duel
item.flightsuit.hero_mk4_capsule: Hero of Twilight Mark 4 Suit Capsule
tooltip.flightsuit.class.hero: Hero: Master Sword (sword beams at full health) · [X] spin attack · [C] clawshot · Hylian shield
message.flightsuit.no_skill: This suit doesn't have that skill.
message.flightsuit.judgment_gauge: Judgment Draw gauge %s/%s (land cards to fill it)
message.flightsuit.duel_no_target: Aim at someone to duel (a monster within 24 blocks).
screen.flightsuit.duel.hint: Get close to 21 without going over. The house stands on 17. Ties go to the phantom. One bottom deal a hand.
screen.flightsuit.duel.sleight_hint: The top and bottom of the deck. Take one (the top card left behind goes to the house).
message.flightsuit.wanderer_arrived: Wanderer %s has come to your village. Talk to them to take them in.
message.flightsuit.resident_downed: %s is down! Right-click them with food within %s seconds for first aid.
message.flightsuit.resident_first_aid_hi: %s: down (%ss). Right-click with food for first aid.
message.flightsuit.resident_no_village: %s: there is no village here to take them in.
command.flightsuit.no_village: Stand inside a village (near its hall).
screen.flightsuit.resident.wanderer_ask: %s would like to live in this village. Take them in?
screen.flightsuit.job_later: Talent ★%s · no work for this job yet (clothes only)
message.flightsuit.build_done: A %s has been finished in your village.
board.flightsuit.need_beds: No free bed, so no wanderers
board.flightsuit.title: %s's Village · %s
proposal.flightsuit.hall_2: 6 residents: can grow into a village
proposal.flightsuit.hall_3: 15 residents: can grow into a tech city
message.flightsuit.order_locked: %s can't be built yet (village stage too low).
message.flightsuit.order_outside: That spot is outside the village or crosses its edge.
message.flightsuit.order_overlap: It overlaps another building (or a planned one).
message.flightsuit.order_ground: Something there can't be broken (bedrock or the like).
message.flightsuit.order_placed: Ordered: %s. The architects are on their way.
message.flightsuit.proposal_gone: That suggestion is no longer there.
message.flightsuit.blueprint_given: Got the blueprint: %s. Hold it and look where it should go.
message.flightsuit.blueprint_pinned: Spot pinned. Right-click the same spot again to confirm (sneak to turn).
message.flightsuit.stage_up: Your village grew into a %s! New blueprints are open.
tooltip.flightsuit.blueprint: Right-click the ground: pin the spot, again on it: confirm. Sneak + right-click: turn.
screen.flightsuit.build.take_hint: Gives you the blueprint. Hold it where it should go (materials are paid from the storage while building).
board.flightsuit.no_seeds: Farmers: no seeds (put some in the storage)
message.flightsuit.blueprint_pinned_clea: Spot pinned. %s blocks will be bulldozed first (they go to the storage). Right-click the same spot again to confirm, sneak to turn.
board.flightsuit.alarm_hint: Sneak + right-click the hall: call it off
message.flightsuit.remote_storage_full: Station storage is full · Left on the ground
message.flightsuit.remote_no_storage: No station storage · Left on the ground (place one within 8 blocks of the suit station)
general.flightsuit.guan_yu.arrive: Guan Yunchang of the Green Dragon Blade is here. Stand aside!
general.flightsuit.guan_yu.duel: %s! I challenge you to single combat. Soldiers, stand back!
general.flightsuit.guan_yu.duel_lapsed: You turn your back... then there is no duel.
general.flightsuit.guan_yu.duel_lost: I am beaten... as promised, my army lays down its arms.
general.flightsuit.guan_yu.wounded: A deep wound. Let me catch my breath.
general.flightsuit.guan_yu.greet: %s, Guan Yu will guard this village.
general.flightsuit.guan_yu.kneel: A beaten general has nothing to say. I await your judgement.
general.flightsuit.zhang_fei.roar: I am Zhang Yide of Yan! Who dares face me?!
general.flightsuit.zhang_fei.greet: %s! Fancy a drink? Leave the village to Zhang Fei!
general.flightsuit.zhang_fei.kneel: Lost is lost. Do as you like!
general.flightsuit.xiahou_dun.arrive: Xiahou Dun of Wei. Sweep this village away!
general.flightsuit.xiahou_dun.enrage: This body was my parents' gift - I won't throw it away! Come!
general.flightsuit.xiahou_dun.defeated: Even with one eye... I didn't see that coming.
general.flightsuit.xiahou_dun.wounded: Not finished yet. Just catching my breath.
general.flightsuit.xiahou_dun.greet: %s, Xiahou Dun's blade is yours now.
general.flightsuit.xiahou_dun.kneel: Kill me or spare me - decide quickly.
general.flightsuit.gan_ning.arrive: Hear the bells? Then it's already too late!
general.flightsuit.gan_ning.defeated: Tch, on the river I'd have won.
general.flightsuit.gan_ning.greet: Boss %s! Gan Ning's got your back.
general.flightsuit.gan_ning.kneel: You're an interesting one. Maybe I'll tag along?
raid.flightsuit.scouts: The %s army will strike the village at dusk today
raid.flightsuit.start: The %s army has camped outside the village
raid.flightsuit.start_fire: The %s army has camped outside the village · preparing a fire attack!
raid.flightsuit.wave2_fire: Wave 2: archers with burning arrows! Watch for fire
raid.flightsuit.wave3: Main force: %s leads it in person
raid.flightsuit.surrender: The %s army laid down its arms · %s
raid.flightsuit.button_recruit_hint: Soldiers join the village as soldier residents; generals become allied generals guarding it
raid.flightsuit.button_release_hint: Free the prisoners. Their kingdom will remember (better relations)
raid.flightsuit.no_surrender: No surrender is waiting for a decision.
raid.flightsuit.no_hall: The village hall isn't loaded. Try again near the village.
raid.flightsuit.released: Released the %s prisoners. Their kingdom will remember this.
raid.flightsuit.won: Drove off the %s army · the spoils went to the village storage
raid.flightsuit.retreat: The %s army pulled back · looted %s kinds of goods from the storage
command.flightsuit.raid_running: This village is already under attack.
command.flightsuit.no_raid: No raid under way in this village.
message.flightsuit.born: %s and %s had a baby, %s! Grown up in %s days. Send them to school and their talents grow.
message.flightsuit.grown_up: %s is grown up (%s lessons · best at: %s). Give them a job.
screen.flightsuit.child.hint: Children don't work yet. With a school and a teacher they have lessons every day, and when they grow up their talents (★) rise by what they learned - most in the job they're drawn to.
